headline: 10 Michigan deals, $259.5M raised — led by Oa Clo Fund, LP

top_deals.summary: Oa Clo Fund, LP, a Grand Rapids-based private equity fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $255.4M sold to 8 investors.
Gentherm Inc (THRM) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement; filing cites a figure of ~$210M.
Ludlow Ventures Detroit V LP, an Oak Park-based venture capital fund, disclosed a $60M raise; $0 sold.
Joint Investment Limited Partnership, a Canton-based hedge fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $2.2M sold to 6 investors. (Amended filing.)
MI XAI Investment, LLC, a Plymouth-based technology company, filed a $1.8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $1.8M sold to 42 investors.

notable_ma.summary: Kelly Services Inc (KELYA) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Hunt Equity Opportunities, LLC.
Terence E. Adderley Revocable Trust K and others reported a 1.3% stake in Kelly Services Inc (KELYA) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 4).
Hunt Equity Opportunities, LLC and others reported a 92.2% stake in Kelly Services Inc (KELYA).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $259.5M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, up 161% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was MI XAI Investment, LLC (Plymouth, Other Technology) targeting $1.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?
Gentherm Inc (THRM) disclosed a deal. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan manufacturing & automotive assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

3 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $257.5M raised so far — led by Oa Clo Fund, LP (Private Equity Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
